🤖 AUTO-ON — Data fetched automatically every refresh cycle
Yahoo Finance
Price & Fundamentals · PRIMARY
● AUTO-ON
Live 15-min delayed quotes, 52W range, RSI/ATR/volume, analyst targets (low/mean/high), revenue growth, profit margin, PEG, beta, market cap, earnings date. Quarterly results: last 4 quarters of revenue, gross margin, net income, free cash flow, and EPS surprise vs estimate. Free — no API key, no rate limit. Primary source for all candle + fundamental data.
finance.yahoo.com ↗
Finnhub
News & Catalysts · Live Quotes
● AUTO-ON
Real-time quotes (every 30s), bid/ask order book (spread & liquidity), analyst recommendations, earnings calendar, company news & insider sentiment. Rate-limited to 55 req/min free tier. Used as primary source for live prices and bid-ask spread.
finnhub.io ↗
ApeWisdom
Social Sentiment · Reddit / WSB
● AUTO-ON
Reddit (WSB, stocks, investing) + Twitter mention counts, rank velocity, 24h change. Single API call covers entire universe (~250 tickers). Refreshed every 5 minutes. Contributes 20% weight to Quant Score.
apewisdom.io ↗
Alpha Vantage
Fundamentals & Technicals · FALLBACK
● AUTO-OFF
Cash-flow, earnings surprise history, sector performance — 25 calls/day free. Used only as fallback when Yahoo Finance data is missing for market cap or fundamentals. Prioritises highest pop_score tickers first.
alphavantage.co ↗
SEC EDGAR
Insider Transactions · Form 4
● AUTO-ON
Form 4 insider buy/sell transactions via SEC-API. Tracks director & officer open-market purchases as a bullish signal. Contributes to the insider scoring component. Cached 1 hour.
sec-api.io ↗
Financial Modeling Prep
Fundamentals & Earnings · FALLBACK
● ACTIVE
Fallback data source for tickers where Yahoo Finance returns no data (OTC ADRs, recently-IPO'd stocks, micro caps). Covers: real-time quotes, quarterly income statements, EPS surprise history, company profiles, key ratios. Free tier: 250 req/day. Key configured — auto-activates when yfinance returns empty results.
financialmodelingprep.com ↗

Dilution Check

When a company sells new shares, your slice of it gets smaller — the business is simply divided into more pieces. Companies do this when buyers are keen, which means a good run in the price is often when it happens. It is all filed publicly and almost nobody looks. This ranks every name we follow by how much its share count actually grew over the last year.

Hype Check

Coverage arrives late. Across 2,148 recoveries from falls of 50% or more, attention peaked a median seven months after the low — by which point 86% of the move had already happened. So this starts where the damage is, not where the noise is.

Pre IPO Stocks

The world's most valuable private companies, ranked by their latest funding-round and secondary-market valuations — so the day one of them files to list, you already know the story.

🚀What this section is
What this isA ranked watchlist of the world’s most valuable private companies — the ones most likely to arrive on a public exchange next.
What the number meansThe latest primary funding round or secondary-market mark. It is a negotiated price, not a traded one, so it moves in steps and can sit still for months.
How to use itLearn the business before there is a ticker to react to. Tap any company for its profile, revenue and our read on it.
Loading the private markets…

Valuations are from the latest reported primary round or secondary-market marks and can be stale or disputed. Private companies do not report on a public timetable. Education only — not a recommendation, not advice, and not FCA-authorised. Capital at risk.

Capex Chains

Not a screener and not a chart. Each map takes one macro driver — AI capex, the power build-out, the defense budget — and shows where the money has already landed, layer by layer, company by company.

📖 How to Use TickerMover

📐 Quant Score

Composite 0–100 score combining momentum (40%), social velocity (20%), technical signals (20%), fundamentals (10%), and market cap fit (10%). Scores above 70 indicate strong setups. Only $1B+ market cap stocks qualify.

🎯 Grades & Ratings

A → ★★★★★ Top Tier · B → ★★★★ Quality · C → ★★★ Average · D → ★★ Below Avg · F → ★ Weak. The Hot List shows only ★★★★★ Top Tier (grade A) with confidence ≥ 75% and market cap ≥ $1B. Use All Stocks tab to browse all grades. Note: these are quality descriptors, not buy/sell recommendations — TickerMover is a research tool, not an FCA-authorised adviser.

🔄 Data Refresh

Live prices update every 30s from /api/quotes/batch. Fast refresh (quotes + social) every 5 min. Slow refresh (candles, fundamentals, insider) every 60 min starting 90s after boot.

⭐ Watchlist

Save any ticker you want to keep an eye on. Saved on your browser via localStorage. Tap the ★ icon on any stock card to add or remove, or type a ticker directly in the Watchlist tab.
